subject: Existing Erya world-map selection surface

reference.observed: One continuous painted biome map, eight named journey regions, painted serif labels and leader diamonds, coastline and one detached underground inset. No artist-authored region mattes or hidden layers are supplied.

ownership.backdrop: One atomic, unchanged Sprite containing the existing artwork and painted lettering. No region pixels are cut, duplicated, repainted or independently translated.
ownership.regions: Eight independent native Pixi Containers with Graphics borders and matching Polygon hit areas. Stable ids and status/entry permissions remain sourced from the existing region and playtest data. Existing DOM marker buttons supply the semantic keyboard/gamepad controls and licensed UI typography.
ownership.route: Independent native Graphics survey route retaining the existing journey order.
ownership.host: The real map binder owns async Application setup, shared Assets texture loading, resize, bounded ticker activity, reduced-motion and visibility listeners. The typed scene factory owns only its Container hierarchy and federated listeners.
ownership.inference: Image-guided region contours follow visible coast/biome transitions. Interior boundaries on this continuous painting are inferred gameplay partitions, not recovered artist mattes. The Refuge is not a named selectable chapter in the current map and is not given a new entry permission.

occlusion.completion: None. The camera zooms the complete registered scene, never extracts a moving land cutout. No underlying layer is exposed and no hidden content is invented.
occlusion.protected: All original decoded image pixels, painted labels, unrelated UI, region information and release/progression gates. Only native overlay nodes and the common camera transform change.

motion.focalMoment: Hover or focus a geographic region: a closed warm survey border identifies its full footprint while the intact map eases toward that region.
motion.pivot: Authoritative region centre, constrained to keep its outline inside the viewport and prevent uncovered canvas.
motion.reset: Pointer leave with no focused region returns the common camera to scale1. The last inspected info panel remains readable. Switching regions starts from the current transform; zoom never compounds.
motion.reducedMotion: User setting or system preference suppresses camera movement and tweening while retaining the border and inspection feedback.
motion.idle: No continuous effect loop. Stop the host ticker when the bounded transition settles or the document is hidden.

acceptance: Use the normal existing application, not a demo or alternative map.
All eight named region footprints respond to actual geographic pointer movement, not just tiny markers; borders align with the source painting.
Native scene nodes and hit areas remain independently controllable; hiding/moving a border cannot change any artwork pixels or reveal a ghost/hole.
At source dimensions, the actual native backdrop render compares with the admitted working image; metrics are diagnostics, not invented fidelity scores.
Inspect intermediate motion, every region extreme, switching, leave/reset and repeated use at desktop and mobile widths.
Existing keyboard/gamepad focus, playable selection, unavailable chapters and Return to Title retain their behavior.
Verify system and application Reduced Motion, resize, disposal/re-entry and missing-resource behavior; inspect browser errors and run the integrated build.

review.reason: Requested map interaction accepted; no further corrections. The user explicitly authorized one additional bounded pointer-up teardown repair after the original correction limit. Final evidence and history bindings are in review.json.
